summaries.title: Mini-Omni: Language Models Can Hear, Talk While Thinking in Streaming
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」痛点，作者围绕 **Mini-Omni** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖多模态与统一基座（Multimodal）。核心论点主张：This paper introduces the Mini-Omni, an audio-based end-to-end conversational model, capable of real-time speech interaction。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We also introduce the VoiceAssistant-400K dataset to fine-tune models optimized for speech output。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（To our best knowledge, Mini-Omni is the first fully end-to-end, open-source model for real-time speech interaction, offering valuable potential for future research）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 53 赞），本工作修正了对 **原生全模态与语音交互 (Omni & Audio)** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: VisionTS: Visual Masked Autoencoders Are Free-Lunch Zero-Shot Time Series Forecasters
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **VisionTS** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we explore a new road to building a TSF foundation model from rich and high-quality natural images, based on the intrinsic similarities between images and time...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **ImageNet**。实验设计与验证细节：To bridge the gap between the two domains, we reformulate the TSF task as an image reconstruction task, which is further processed by a visual masked autoencoder...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（With minimal fine-tuning, VisionTS could further improve the forecasting and achieve state-of-the-art performance in most cases）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 39 赞），本工作为突破 **训练与强化学习** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
